newsitem.title: USA: Technicals support NYMEX ACCESS energy prices.
newsitem.headline: Technicals support NYMEX ACCESS energy prices.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices edged higher in quiet overnight trade, as technical support helped extend the daytime rally, brokers said.
Volumes remained light after-hours, market players said, with few refiners in the market.
"It's a continuation from today. There are no fundamentals in the market," one broker said, noting crude prices were range-bound, after ending the day 51 cents stronger.
April NYMEX rose seven cents a barrel from the settle to trade $20.69, amid 300 lots traded overall and 170 traded overall.
Daytime prices rose despite reports of higher U.S. crude supplies, which futures traders had expected. Crude futures ended a two-day skid, finding support at $19.96.

NYMEX heating oil traded at 54.25 cents a gallon, up 0.17 cents from the settle amid volume of 61 lots in April and 181 in all months. Gasoline was bought at 64.90 cents, up 0.27 cents as 18 lots changed hands in April, traders said.
